assumptions: Resolved “She” to Tim, the only named runner, despite the pronoun mismatch.
Interpreted “3 times a week” as three running days per week because the source describes the increase in days and the duration for every day the person runs.
f3_program: observe(at("tim.running.days_per_week", "initial"), 3, "day_per_week", source("Tim used to run 3 times a week"))
add("add_running_days", "tim", at("tim.running.days_per_week", "current"), 2, source("add an extra 2 days a week"))
observe(at("tim.running.evening_duration", "each_running_day"), 1, "hour", source("1 hour in the morning and 1 in the evening"))

sum_relation("tim.running.daily_duration", at("tim.running.morning_duration", "each_running_day"), at("tim.running.evening_duration", "each_running_day"), source("She runs 1 hour in the morning and 1 in the evening every day she runs"))

rate_relation(at("tim.running.weekly_duration", "now"), "tim.running.daily_duration", at("tim.running.days_per_week", "current"), source("She runs 1 hour in the morning and 1 in the evening every day she runs"))

assumptions: All patrons in the two waiting groups are interpreted as the patrons Ellen must transport.

member("overflow_lot.waiting_patrons", "overflow_lot.waiting_patrons.from_cars", source("12 patrons who came in cars"))
member("overflow_lot.waiting_patrons", "overflow_lot.waiting_patrons.from_bus", source("27 from a bus waiting in the overflow parking lot"))
